name: Grilled Pork Chops with Peach-Cucumber Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 peaches
1 ½ English cucumber
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, combine and mix together olive oil, paprika, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; rub with the spice mixture on both sides.

Place the pork chops in the grill pan / skillet and sear until they develop a nice crust, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Then, reduce the heat to medium and cook the chops, flipping occasionally, until they are cooked through (test using a thermometer or cut into a chop with a knife), another 3 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer the pork to a plate.
Juice the limes and transfer to a large salad bowl.
To the lime juice, add olive oil, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp honey
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Quarter the peaches lengthwise (around the pit) and twist the quarters to separate, then remove and discard the pit; cut each quarter lengthwise into thin wedges and add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; halve the cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into 6-mm-thick half-rounds at an angle. Add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the shallots; peel and halve the shallots lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-rounds. Add to the salad bowl and toss the salad to combine.
To serve, divide the pork chops and salad between plates. Enjoy!
